description: Independent intended outcomes from business facts; no measured results or timings are stored in this plan.

The service declares anchor_record but explicitly reports it unsupported.
Persisted fault selects this request for HTTP 503; failure_every=1 removes chance from this scenario.

The formerly EOA executor has code before dispatch and the supported EOA proof no longer applies.
